name: security-filter-send-default-type
description: With Ask me each time: a forward rule of the default type (17, new mail and by hand) opens a dialog that names both: new mail as it arrives, and the messages already there when run by hand. Nothing is written, nothing is sent.

checks.contains: This rule will automatically send matching incoming mail, every time, without review.
Run by hand (Run Filters on Folder or on Selected Messages), it also sends the matching messages already there.
Runs on: new mail (before junk classification), manual run
